why: No major reviewer answers this exact question with a tested roundup, but several answer parts of it. Good Housekeeping tested 25W 3-in-1 stations in a general wireless-charger guide. WIRED tested 25W 3-in-1s, but as travel chargers. Macworld has lab-tested reviews of single stands (ESR at $99.99, Kuxiu, Satechi). The only true answer is knowledgelib, an untested aggregator; the rest are brand pages, deal posts and listicles. A focused page could get in, but it would be up against well-known sites with partial coverage.
